verdict.rationale: Delegating tasks to an AI assistant is Grok Bot's core function. The docs say you create a Bot, describe the job in a message, and it works on a persistent cloud computer while your laptop is closed. Bots keep memory across sessions, save skills, run on schedules, and hand tasks to other Bots. A month-long user independently reports async delegation that 'actually works', including a bot negotiating with ~40 suppliers alongside a second bot.
